rescue_bio: I have rehomed and spay/nuter chip rabies & cat vacines since 1975 well over 10,000 in my lifetime! I'm a solo senior entrepreneur with vetting experience! All kittys will be spay/nuter' fully vacinated & a chip & a rabies shot for permanent rehoming! All these loving kittys are socialized with other kittys , dogs and lots of humans ! Especially with Seniors daily!!! I also work with South County Spay/Nuter Project in Renton, WA.
rescue_pricing: Kitty vaccine cost $30 · Spay/neuter with chip and rabies vaccine $125
